milestones.title: Manifest ingestion and dependency analysis

criteria.text: Multipart and raw manifest upload endpoints accept requirements.txt and package.json
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_api.py (4 tests passing) verifying multipart upload and raw text endpoints for both requirements.txt and package.json with versioned /api/v1 parity.

criteria.text: Dependencies safely parsed without code execution
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_parser.py (12 tests passing) confirming safe zero-execution parsing of exact pins, non-pinned constraints, environment markers, inline comments, preserved pip directives (-r, -e), PEP 508 direct references (@ url), and package.json with unsupported specifier preservation.

criteria.text: PyPI and npm registry clients query available versions with caching
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_registry_clients.py (20 tests passing) confirming official PyPI JSON and npm registry queries, thread-safe in-memory TTL caching, strict streamed reading without .content/.json fallback bypass, stream failure containment, Content-Length checks, redirect controls, SSRF rejection, and thread-local session isolation.

criteria.text: Outdated packages classified into Up-to-Date, Upgrade Available, or Preserved
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_service.py and tests/test_semver_evaluator.py (27 tests passing) confirming fail-closed SemVer evaluation, bounded concurrency (max_workers=8), stable result ordering matching manifest input sequence, error isolation, and deterministic classification into UP_TO_DATE, UPGRADE_AVAILABLE, and PRESERVED.

criteria.text: Malformed manifests fail gracefully with diagnostic error responses
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_api.py (7 tests passing) confirming HTTP 422 diagnostic responses on malformed JSON and empty content, HTTP 400 on unsupported extensions, and HTTP 413 on both raw text and multipart uploads exceeding the 1MB cap.
